description: Set a simple Yes/No App content policy declaration, using Play Console's own web session. Mandatory declaration gating production submission eligibility. Currently supports policy_declaration="advertising_id" (does the app use advertising ID?) or "government_app" (is this app developed by or on behalf of a government?).

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

policy_declaration.description: Which declaration to set: "advertising_id" or "government_app". Other App content declarations (data safety, content rating, target audience, ads, sign in details, financial features, health) have their own tools or are not yet supported.

policy_declaration_answer.description: "true" or "false" answer to the declaration's Yes/No question.

name: update_policy_declaration
